cases.brief: Manual SiMn entry is missing after saving the EAF logsheet
cases.description: The shift operator entered a SiMn addition in the EAF logsheet and saved it, but the value was not visible when the screen was reopened. The affected heat number, entry time and entered quantity were not included in the handover. Please help us identify what details are needed to investigate this occurrence.
